
        <h2>
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/handsome12345/p/19102974" title="发布于 2025-09-20 22:47">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">CentOS 8.5.2.111部署Zabbix6.0 手把手、保姆级</span>
    

</a>

        </h2>
        <div class="postbody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        本文详细记录了在CentOS 8.5.2.111系统上部署Zabbix 6.0的全过程。内容涵盖：1）系统准备（设置网络、更新源、关闭防火墙）；2）MySQL安装与配置（修改认证方式、设置密码策略）；3）Zabbix安装（配置清华源、安装必要组件）；4）数据库初始化（创建库/用户、导入数据）；5）服务启动与Web界面访问。文中特别强调了常见错误解决方法，如源配置报错、MySQL启动失败等，并提供了完整的操作脚本。最终通过http://服务器IP/zabbix访问，默认账号Admin/zabbix。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>CentOS 8.5.2.111部署Zabbix6.0 手把手、保姆级</p>
<p><span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></span></p>
<p><span id="cke_bm_2615S">&nbsp;CentOS 8.5.2.111部署Zabbix6.0</span></p>

<p>Zabbix由2部分构成，Zabbix&nbsp;<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="27" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1"><a class="cke_widget_editable cke_widget_element" title="server" href="https://baike.baidu.com/item/server/8873208?fromModule=lemma_inlink" data-cke-enter-mode="2" data-cke-saved-href="https://baike.baidu.com/item/server/8873208?fromModule=lemma_inlink" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fbaike.baidu.com%2Fitem%2Fserver%2F8873208%3FfromModule%3Dlemma_inlink%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22server%22%2C%22desc%22%3A%22%22%2C%22icon%22%3A%22%22%2C%22isCard%22%3Afalse%2C%22hasResquest%22%3Atrue%2C%22iconDefault%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcsdnimg.cn%2Frelease%2Fblog_editor_html%2Frelease2.4.2%2Fckeditor%2Fplugins%2FCsdnLink%2Ficons%2Ficon-default.png%3Ft%3DP7R7%22%2C%22id%22%3A%22PclAaT-1758418145618%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-editable="text" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-link-icon="https://csdnimg.cn/release/blog_editor_html/release2.4.2/ckeditor/plugins/CsdnLink/icons/icon-default.png?t=P7R7" data-link-title="server" data-widget="csdnlink" rel="noopener nofollow">server</a>与可选组件Zabbix agent。</span></p>
<p>Zabbix server可以通过<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="26" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1"><a class="cke_widget_editable cke_widget_element" title="SNMP" href="https://baike.baidu.com/item/SNMP/133378?fromModule=lemma_inlink" data-cke-enter-mode="2" nofollow">SNMP</a>，Zabbix agent，ping，端口监视等方法提供对远程服务器/网络状态的监视，数据收集等功能，它可以运行在<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="25" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1"><a class="cke_widget_editable cke_widget_element" title="Linux" data-link-icon="https://csdnimg.cn/release/blog_editor_html/release2.4.2/ckeditor/plugins/CsdnLink/icons/icon-default.png?t=P7R7" data-link-title="OpenBSD" data-widget="csdnlink" rel="noopener nofollow">OpenBSD</a>，<span class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_inline cke_widget_csdnlink cke_widget_selected" data-cke-display-name="a" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="19" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1"><a class="cke_widget_editable cke_widget_element" title="OS X" href="https://baike.baidu.com/item/OS%20X/426765?fromModule=lemma_inlink" data-cke-enter-mode="2" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22url%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fbaike.baidu.com%2Fitem%2FOS%2520X%2F426765%3FfromModule%3Dlemma_inlink%22%2C%22text%22%3A%22OS%20X%22%2C%22desc%22%3A%22%22%2C%22icon%22%3A%22%22%2C%22isCard%22%3Afalse%2C%22hasResquest%22%3Atrue%2C%22iconDefault%22%3A%22https%3A%2F%2Fcsdnimg.cn%2Frelease%2Fblog_editor_html%2Frelease2.4.2%2Fckeditor%2Fplugins%2FCsdnLink%2Ficons%2Ficon-default.png%3Ft%3DP7R7%22%2C%22id%22%3A%224hfgrv-1758418145613%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-editable="text" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-link-icon="https://csdnimg.cn/release/blog_editor_html/release2.4.2/ckeditor/plugins/CsdnLink/icons/icon-default.png?t=P7R7" data-link-title="OS X" data-widget="csdnlink" rel="noopener nofollow">OS X</a>等平台上。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 18pt">鉴于此，工作需要，尝试CentOS 8.5.2.111安装Zabbix6.0 ，躺过一些坑，为了避免今后继续填坑及后人踩坑，记录一下：</span></p>
<p><span data-cke-copybin-start="1"><span data-cke-copybin-end="1">​</span></span>前提、设置网络Ip地址等</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">cd /etc/sysconfig
cd network-scripts/
ls
vim ifcfg-enp0s3
systemctl restart NetworkManager
ping www.baidu.com
</pre>
</div>
<p>重启网络服务，效果不好时重启服务器</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">systemctl restart NetworkManager
reboot
</pre>
</div>
<p><em>0、安装中文语言包</em></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">yum install glibc-langpack-zh.x86_64</pre>
</div>
<p>1、交互式选择源，更加方便。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">bash &lt;(curl -sSL https://gitee.com/SuperManito/LinuxMirrors/raw/main/ChangeMirrors.sh)
</pre>
</div>
<p>测试源是否可用？</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">yum makecache
</pre>
</div>
<p>1.1、查看、设置主机名</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">hostname
hostnamectl set-hostname zabbix6.Centos8.5
hostnamectl status
</pre>
</div>
<p><em><em><em><em><em>2.1</em></em></em></em></em></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">关闭防火墙

systemctl stop firewalld.service
开机不启动防火墙
systemctl disable firewalld.service
关闭linux 内核安全措施
setenforce 0
关闭日后linux 内核安全启动措施
sed -i "s/SELINUX=enforcing/SELINUX=disabled/g" /etc/selinux/config
防火墙状态
systemctl status firewalld
systemctl status selinux-autorelabel
</pre>
</div>
<p><em id="__mceDel">3、安装MYSQL准备</em></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">yum remove -y mysql #卸载之前安装的mysql
下载
wget https://dev.mysql.com/get/mysql80-community-release-el8-1.noarch.rpm
yum install mysql80-community-release-el8-1.noarch.rpm
yum module disable mysql
yum install mysql-community-server --nogpgcheck
vim /etc/my.cnf

default-authentication-plugin=mysql_native_password
#把这上面这一行的注释#去掉，没有的直接加上
</pre>
</div>
<p>4、MYSQL初始化</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">mysql -V
rpm -qa | grep mysql
开启Mysql
systemctl restart mysqld
service mysqld status
查询临时密码,看到临时密码，要记录下来，用这个密码去更改mysql的管理员密码，并写到后续的配置中
grep 'temporary password' /var/log/mysqld.log
mysql -u root -p
</pre>
</div>
<p>5、MYSQL密码配置，修改root密码：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">ALTER USER 'root'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY 'yourPassWord'; #第一步需要先创建一个复杂一点的密码root_21ROOT
SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'validate_password%'; #查看、修改密码策略

set global validate_password.policy=0; #这个我没执行
SHOW VARIABLES LIKE 'validate_password%'; #查看、修改密码策略

create user 'root'@'%' identified by 'yourPassWord';
grant all privileges on *.* to 'root'@'%' with grant option; #授权

exit #退出mysql,否则后面语句执行不了。</pre>
</div>
<p>下载 zabbix安装包和配置文件源包：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">rpm -Uvh https://repo.zabbix.com/zabbix/6.0/rhel/8/x86_64/zabbix-release-6.0-4.el8.noarch.rpm
dnf clean all
cd /etc/yum.repos.d
ls
</pre>
</div>
<p><em id="__mceDel"><em id="__mceDel">vim zabbix.repo #复制粘贴我页面提供的文本，到zabbix.repo 并保存</em></em></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<p># 3、配置zabbix.repo文件仓库，把zabbix.repo 设置成如下内容，<br><span style="font-family: &quot;Courier New&quot;; font-size: 12px">vim zabbix.repo #复制粘贴我页面提供的文本，到zabbix.repo 并保存</span></p>
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;"># repo文件开始
[zabbix]
name=Zabbix Official Repository - $basearch
#baseurl=https://repo.zabbix.com/zabbix/6.0/rhel/8/$basearch/
baseurl=https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/zabbix/zabbix/6.0/rhel/8/x86_64/ 
#上面是 zabbix清华源
enabled=1
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-ZABBIX-A14FE591

[zabbix-non-supported]
name=Zabbix Official Repository (non-supported) - $basearch
#baseurl=https://repo.zabbix.com/non-supported/rhel/8/$basearch/
baseurl=https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/zabbix/non-supported/rhel/8/x86_64/ 
#上面是 zabbix-non-supported清华源
enabled=1
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-ZABBIX
gpgcheck=1

[zabbix-unstable]
name=Zabbix Official Repository (unstable) - $basearch
baseurl=https://repo.zabbix.com/zabbix/5.5/rhel/8/$basearch/
enabled=0
gpgcheck=1
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-ZABBIX-A14FE591
# repo文件结束
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<p><em id="__mceDel"><em id="__mceDel">vim zabbix-agent2-plugins.repo #复制粘贴我页面提供的文本，到zabbix-agent2-plugins.repo 并保存</em></em></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">vim zabbix-agent2-plugins.repo #复制粘贴我页面提供的文本，到zabbix-agent2-plugins.repo 并保存

# 4、配置zabbix-agent2-plugins.repo文件仓库
[root@centos8 yum.repos.d]# vim zabbix-agent2-plugins.repo 
# repo文件开始
[zabbix-agent2-plugins]
name=Zabbix Official Repository (Agent2 Plugins) - $basearch
#baseurl=https://repo.zabbix.com/zabbix-agent2-plugins/1/rhel/8/$basearch/
baseurl=https://mirrors.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/zabbix/zabbix-agent2-plugins/1/rhel/8/x86_64/ 
# agent2清华源
enabled=1
gpgkey=file:///etc/pki/rpm-gpg/RPM-GPG-KEY-ZABBIX
gpgcheck=1
# repo文件结束
[root@centos8 yum.repos.d]# 
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>7、初始化数据库：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">mysql -u root -p

mysql&gt; create database zabbix character set utf8mb4 collate utf8mb4_bin; # 创建zabbix数据库

mysql&gt; create user zabbix@localhost identified WITH sha256_password BY 'password'; #创建zabbix数据库密码password

mysql&gt; grant all privileges on zabbix.* to zabbix@localhost;

mysql&gt; set global log_bin_trust_function_creators = 1;

mysql&gt;use mysql;

mysql&gt;delete from user where user=' ';#我这句没执行

mysql&gt;flush privileges;

mysql&gt; quit;<br><br></pre>
</div>
<p>安装zabbix 相关模块</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">dnf install zabbix-server-mysql zabbix-web-mysql zabbix-apache-conf zabbix-sql-scripts zabbix-selinux-policy zabbix-agent2</pre>
</div>
<p>导入初始化数据库脚本</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">zcat /usr/share/zabbix-sql-scripts/mysql/server.sql.gz | mysql --default-character-set=utf8mb4 -uzabbix -p zabbix
</pre>
</div>
<p><em id="__mceDel"><em id="__mceDel">mysql -u root -p</em></em></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">mysql&gt; set global log_bin_trust_function_creators = 0;
mysql&gt; quit;
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<p>8、启动zibbx 程序及agen:，开机自启相关服务。</p>
<p>vim /etc/zabbix/zabbix_server.conf # 取消注释 DBPassword= 并设置数据库密码<br>重启zabbix服务</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:bash;gutter:true;">systemctl restart zabbix-server zabbix-agent2 httpd php-fpm

systemctl enable zabbix-server zabbix-agent2 httpd php-fpm
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　</p>
<p>9、打开zabbix:<br>http://192.168.1.180/zabbix</p>
<p>用户名：Admin</p>
<p>密码：zabbix</p>
